title: Junta restriction dimension
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The junta restriction dimension is the number of coordinates outside $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$.
